newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves into the banking system on Thursday through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements, a New York Fed spokeswoman confirmed.
The operation was a mild surprise. Most analysts had figured the Fed would execute four-day system RPs, although some said there was a chance of overnight system RPs.

Analysts noted that with a $1.5-2.0 billion daily add need seen in the second half of the maintenance period and Tuesday's two-day system RP operation running off, an operation this session was certain.
Thursday's RP was projected at $2.0-3.0 billion.
Fed funds were trading at the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target rate.
